scope: Local React operator, Vite proxy, FastAPI composed app and SQLite
fixes: The local launcher supplies SKYGUARD_API_KEY to FastAPI and the Vite proxy, and SKYGUARD_DB_API_KEY to persistence. The browser sends the persistence bearer only on the local authenticated path.
The composed app mounts the actual synchronized camera bridge. Idle returns null image and zero detections.
The composed app stores media job status and summary in sg_media_jobs from revision 0002. Media files stay on disk.
The operator starts analysis when a file is selected and renders the annotated output. Conflicts marked for review are excluded from class totals.

database.method: Read-only inspection and SQLite online backup to a temporary file for the integration runs

limitations: The full 120-frame infrared input reached the 420-second verification deadline. The six-frame infrared and RGB excerpts completed successfully.
Two annotated images and two short clips are insufficient to measure dataset-level precision, recall or field accuracy.
Physical USB/RTSP acquisition, field identity continuity, interactive map tile rendering and deployed gateway were not verified.
The checkpoint exposes DRONE and BIRD. UNKNOWN tracking restrictions were exercised by automated tests; trained UNKNOWN classification was unavailable with this checkpoint.
The default port 8000 was occupied. The HTTP verification used isolated loopback ports and left the pre-existing service in place.
